en-US.title: CAD model preview
en-US.description: Rotate GLB and STL models in the side panel and the reader, with the bounding box in millimetres.

usage.title: Open a model
usage.description: Open a GLB or STL file, such as a part from the CAD module, in the right-hand panel, the Files view or the standalone reader.

usage.title: Turn and measure
usage.description: Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, and use Fit, Top, Front and Iso. The bounding box along the CAD axes is shown under the model.

usage.title: Download the original
usage.description: The original file always downloads unchanged. Files over 25 MiB or 1,000,000 triangles show the reason and a download instead of a preview.

requirements: Ships installed and enabled in this fork. Turn it off with make extension-disable NAME=cad-preview.
Needs WebGL in the browser. A failed build (.failed.glb) is shown with a note pointing to its report.

zh-CN.title: CAD 模型预览
zh-CN.description: 在右侧面板和独立阅读页中旋转查看 GLB 和 STL 模型，并显示以毫米为单位的包围盒。

usage.title: 打开模型
usage.description: 在右侧面板、文件视图或独立阅读页中打开 GLB 或 STL 文件，例如 CAD 模块生成的零件。

usage.title: 旋转与测量
usage.description: 拖动旋转，滚轮或双指缩放，并可使用适应、俯视、前视和轴测视图。模型下方显示沿 CAD 坐标轴的包围盒。

usage.title: 下载原始文件
usage.description: 原始文件始终可原样下载。超过 25 MiB 或 1,000,000 个三角形的文件会显示原因和下载按钮，而不是预览。

requirements: 此分支默认安装并启用。可通过 make extension-disable NAME=cad-preview 关闭。
需要浏览器支持 WebGL。未通过检查的构建（.failed.glb）会显示提示，并指向其报告。
